title: Canonical module strict-local derived restriction and exchange comparison
statement: For module coefficients $A$ and a geometric point $s$ of $B$, let $r$ be the unique natural transformation with the section restrictions of [def-pur-module-strict-local-section-restriction], supplied by [lem-pur-module-strict-local-restriction-properties]. Define the module germ restriction to be this uniquely specified transformation. Derive it using exact stalks and exact strict-local sections, with the canonical exact-functor comparisons. For $f:X\to B$, $X'=X\times_BS$, and a specified coefficient comparison $v^{-1}K\cong K'$, define the canonical map $(Rf_*K)_s\to R\Gamma(X',K')$ by derived germ restriction, the canonical derived exchange mate, the canonical Leray comparison, and this coefficient identification [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. No isomorphism assertion for this map is part of the definition.
